image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a white Apple iPod Classic. The device features a glossy white front face with a color LCD screen displaying a video or menu interface with text and images of people. Below the screen is the signature circular click wheel with a central button. The casing appears to be white plastic with rounded corners. The background is blurred, suggesting a shallow depth of field.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text displayed on the screen is nonsensical and illegible, resembling AI-generated hallucinations rather than real UI typography. Characters are malformed and spacing is irregular.

artifact_observations.location: Screen bezel and click wheel edges
artifact_observations.reasoning: The transition between the screen glass and the white bezel is slightly soft and lacks the crisp, sharp edge definition expected of high-quality product photography or precise rendering. There is slight bleeding/blurring at the boundary.
The circular click wheel appears slightly elliptical or warped, which may be due to perspective but also suggests minor geometric inconsistency in the generation of the rigid object.
